headline: China buys more Russian oil; seeing the impact on India's purchases, Modi immediately found a new route, arranging the deal through ship-to-ship transfer
summary: India's Russian crude imports fell to about 1.9 million barrels per day in September from about 2.1 million in August, after a July high near 2.8 million. Reports say China is buying more Russian oil.
why: Russia is a major crude exporter, and shifts in its buyers between China and India change flows of discounted barrels and global oil trade patterns.
